question: What result follows when the mantra practitioner offers into that fire?
premises: The mantra practitioner offers into that fire.
The offering targets all planetary influences.
inference: Offering into that fire destroys all adverse planetary influences.
uncertainties: sarva-grahaṃ may be read as singular collective or as affecting all planets.
plain_english: The mantra practitioner should offer into that fire, and all adverse planetary influences will be destroyed.
